title: Verkiezingen provinciale staten 1966
authors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: Opinions on some political issues / political alienation / attitude to the roman-catholic people's party ( kvp ) / voting motivations / floating votes / evaluation of government policy / opinions on mining problems. Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
